title: 第一章 方彻
content_zh: 夏日清晨的阳光，穿过枝叶缝隙，透过窗子，斑驳光影，正照在床头。空中的微尘融在光线里，氤氲蒸腾，化作一道道若实质的箭，从九天落下，射在方彻脸上。慢慢的，他感觉到脸上的炙热，悠然醒来。睁开眼睛，却又瞬间闭上。眼皮依然能感应光线的照射。他满足的吐出口气。真的活了。眼睛一闭一睁，便是今生前世。闭眼是死亡时刻黑暗中的灵魂无底沉沦，睁开是新生时刻触摸世界的无边感动。被阳光暴晒的微灼，那是活着的感觉。……起身，穿衣，清除，洗脸。铺纸，研墨，润笔，挥毫。……【沉默是金】随着duangduang的几声锤子响，一块牌匾，钉在了书桌对面墙壁上。方彻退后几步，抬头看看，微微点头。在书桌椅子背后，也有一块匾额。【谨言慎行】桌上竖着一个木框，木框里，依然是四个字：【惜字如金】客厅里。【言多必失】方彻认真点头：“从此以后，我要时刻记着，做一个不苟言笑，谨言慎行的人！”然后他就沉默了。随即就皱眉：“为什么我要这样想？”“我的前世到底是谁？”方彻敲着自己额头。重生到了这具身体里，已经三天了。三天里，他理顺了记忆，融合了灵魂，但是，最最奇怪的是：他知道自己是个重生者，也知道自己占据了这个身体，知道自己经历的很多事情，也知道这是自己那個时代的六百年后。前一世经历的所有所有，都清清楚楚。但是，唯独忘记了自己是谁！方彻很不可理解。但他对于自己重生成了另一个人这种事，出奇的没有任何的抵触。几乎是瞬间就接受了。能够重活一遍还能有什么不知足的？眯着眼睛，看着照眼而来的阳光，脸上露出丝丝的惘然，轻声叹息一声：“哎，也不知道他们和那几个丫头咋样了。”…………这具身体名叫方彻。个人资料如下：方彻。身材不胖不瘦，很帅，很壮。一米七八的个子，一百五十六斤，很挺拔。眉毛稍浓，眉尾稍微上挑，嘴唇稍厚，两眼微微有点内陷，双眼皮但很不明显，只有笑起来的时候，才骤然显现。哦，内双。目光很是冷锐。看着这面相，方彻忍不住就为前身相了个面：这货必然偏激，爱走极端。幸亏我不是。不过，这种冷峻桀骜，比较符合我今生沉默寡言孤僻少语的人设。一身白衣——方彻皱眉，不大喜欢，必须换掉。十七岁。九品武徒。身体健康，资质上等。方氏家族外戚，随母姓方。在方家长大。——这点，方彻就感觉稍有不解了。死于从武徒突破武士阶位。突破武士阶位，就可以参加武院考核了。也是武者人生中第一道‘龙门考验’。众所周知，武徒破境，最好的办法便是找一个修为比他高的人连续战斗，打磨境界，在连续的战斗中，基本都可以顺利在战斗中突破。然后接着那股劲儿，继续战斗中稳固境界，一直到结束战斗，这个突破过程就完成了。——这可以说很简单的常识。——这个过程中，根本不会死人。于是家族派了修炼资质最高的大表哥，也就是家主的嫡长子，专程从武院回来和方彻战斗打磨。这可以说是最稳妥的做法了。因为大表哥方青云已经是武师高阶了，对于武徒和武士的境界，非常熟悉。可以稳妥到了极点的将方彻送入武士的境界。但是却出了意外。前身因此而死了。前来帮忙的大表哥兴致勃勃的一掌拍在表弟丹田，用自身修为刺激表弟丹田之气的时候……表弟一声不吭，啪叽一声。躺地上死了！…………大表哥当场就傻了。我打死了我亲表弟？！这事儿简直了！方氏家族整个家族全员出动，好歹求爷爷告奶奶，全城的神医都请来，将表弟救了回来——于是方彻就这么来了。表弟看起来是活了。但大表哥现在正被大舅吊起来抽。据说场面很残暴。……方彻用自己现有的可怜的灵力，仔仔细细巡查经脉，终于发现……在丹田中，的确有异样。虽然用现在的灵力，察觉不了太具体，但根据方彻的经验，能够做到这一点的，应该是唯我正教的五灵蛊。所谓五灵蛊，据说乃是针对人身修炼金木水火土五种灵力的蛊虫。是害人的毒蛊，但也是某种秘术，因为如果噬灵不死，反而具备了某种资格，而且能辅助修炼……简单来说，不死你就变强。这同样是一种选拔，只是以生死为代价。这是某教的惯用手法。五灵蛊，一旦进入体内，任何修为，都无法炼化！这五灵蛊到底哪儿来的？方彻在搜记忆。貌似……是那家伙？记得在突破前，原身一位‘好朋友’给送了一瓶‘高级’的气血丹？而原身为了突破，已经吃光了。除此之外，再无异样。八九不离十，应该是了。“可真是好朋友啊！”……数千里之外。有个白衣人正向着这边赶来。“三百个五灵蛊，居然都死了？只活了一个？只有这个，还活的很茁壮？这是哪个来着？这个方向……碧波城？”“随手无意的一个小布置，想不到还有意外之喜。”他惊喜的笑了笑，忍不住加快了脚步。看来这次，不仅教内任务可以完成，甚至还能收个传承弟子？………方彻整理出来一箩筐的疑问。毋庸置疑——其中的阴谋算计，以及前身根本不知情的利益纠葛，不知道有多少。无数的线头绕在一起，难以理清。“这里面水太深了兄弟，你把握不住啊。”方彻轻轻叹口气。抬头看着自己刚挂上去的‘谨言慎行’四个字。轻声道：“让我来吧。”一个十七岁的少年，能知道多少？但现在我来了。我就是方彻。倒要摸摸，那些牛鬼蛇神，到底是怎么个神通广大法？他眯起眼睛，看着窗外的刺目阳光。脸色沉静。这无处不在无孔不入的阳光，像极了前世从天而降的那杆枪。当看到的时候，就不可阻挡，无处闪避！…………居身的碧波城乃是在大陆之东，往南五千里，乃是广袤无边的云顶山脉。自己貌似曾经在这段地界方圆数万里之内活动过好久的样子……当初我追杀千毒魔王就是在这里，直接在碧波城之外一千来里的百瘴峰干掉他的！据说这是那家伙的洞府之所在，只是没来得及进去就被自己一刀砍了。而自己那时候压根没看上这种小修的什么宝藏，直接就走了。不过现在，极其需要啊。按照自己记忆，这个区域应该是属于大雍王朝的吧？现在是大赵王朝？看来大雍王朝已经无了？换成了大赵？这事儿居然没有经过老子同意。……敲门声响起。“方兄弟，身体大好了吧？”随着声音，一个青年从门口走了进来，一脸笑容，眼神中带着些许隐藏的审视。面容算是俊俏，只是眉眼间，总显得有些阴鸷。在方彻眼中看去，有着一种难言的恶意。“恩，托福。”方彻眼神一闪，不动声色。就是这家伙，叫苏越！碧波城苏氏家族的二公子。就是他，给了自己那种夹杂着五灵蛊虫的气血丹。这就是害死前身的真正的罪魁祸首，也是前身所谓‘最好的朋友，最好的兄弟’。本来方彻还在怀疑是不是，但是再看到这货的脸和眼神之后，联系记忆立即确定。“不得不说，你这大表哥也忒狠了，这是真不当你是一家人啊。”苏越很随意的走进来坐在方彻对面。心里却在嘀咕，这方家对这个外孙还真是好，居然连五毒蛊都能压制。
content_en: The sunshine in the summer morning passes through the gaps between the branches and leaves, through the window, and the mottled light and shadow is shining on the bedside.The dust in the air melted into the light, steamed up, and turned into a series of solid arrows, falling from the sky and hitting Fang Che's face.Slowly, he felt the heat on his face and woke up leisurely.He opened his eyes, but closed them instantly.The eyelids can still sense light exposure.He let out a sigh of satisfaction.Really alive.When the eyes are closed and opened, it is this life and the past life.Closing the eyes is the bottomless sinking of the soul in the darkness at the moment of death; opening the eyes is the boundless emotion of touching the world at the moment of rebirth.Being slightly burned by the sun is the feeling of being alive.…Get up, dress, clean up, wash your face.Lay the paper, grind the ink, polish the pen, and write the brush.... [Silence is Golden] Following the sound of a hammer from Duangduang, a plaque was nailed to the wall opposite the desk.Fang Che took a few steps back, looked up, and nodded slightly.There is also a plaque behind the desk chair.[Be careful in your words and deeds] There is a wooden frame on the table. In the wooden frame, there are still four words: [Cherish words like gold] In the living room.[Too much words lead to mistakes] Fang Che nodded seriously: "From now on, I will always remember to be a person who is unsmiling and cautious in words and deeds!" Then he fell silent.Then he frowned: "Why do I think like this?" "Who was my previous life?" Fang Che tapped his forehead.It has been three days since I was reborn into this body.In three days, he straightened out his memories and merged his soul. However, the strangest thing was: he knew that he was a reborn person, that he had occupied this body, that he knew many things he had experienced, and that this was six hundred years after his own time.Everything I experienced in my previous life is clear.However, I just forgot who I am!Fang Che was incomprehensible.But he surprisingly had no objection to being reborn as another person.Acceptance was almost instantaneous.What else would you not be satisfied with if you could live your life over again?He squinted his eyes and looked at the sunlight shining in his eyes, with a hint of confusion on his face, and sighed softly: "Hey, I don't know what happened to them and those girls."... This body is named Fang Che.Personal information is as follows: Fang Che.Neither fat nor thin, very handsome and strong.He is 1.78 meters tall, weighs 156 pounds, and is very tall and tall.The eyebrows are slightly thicker, the ends of the eyebrows are slightly raised, the lips are slightly thicker, the eyes are slightly sunken, and the double eyelids are not obvious. They only appear suddenly when smiling.Oh, inside double.His eyes were very cold and sharp.Looking at this face, Fang Che couldn't help but take a look at his predecessor: This guy must be extreme and like to go to extremes.Fortunately I'm not.However, this kind of cold and unruly personality is more in line with my personality of being taciturn, solitary and rarely talking in this life.Wearing white clothes - Fang Che frowned, he didn't like it very much and had to change it.Seventeen years old.Ninth grade martial arts disciple.Good health and excellent qualifications.A relative of the Fang family, he took his mother's surname Fang.Growing up in Fang's family.——At this point, Fang Che felt a little confused.He died when he broke through the warrior rank from a warrior disciple.If you break through the warrior rank, you can take part in the martial arts assessment.It is also the first ‘Dragon Gate Test’ in a warrior’s life.As we all know, the best way for a martial artist to break through a realm is to find someone with a higher level of cultivation than him to fight continuously and polish his realm. In continuous battles, he can basically break through smoothly in battle.Then continue that energy and continue to stabilize your state during the battle until the battle is over. This breakthrough process is completed.——This can be said to be very simple common sense.——No one will die in this process.So the family sent their eldest cousin with the highest qualifications in cultivation, who was the eldest son of the family head, to come back from the martial arts academy to fight and polish Fang Che.This can be said to be the safest approach.Because the eldest cousin Fang Qingyun is already a high-level martial artist and is very familiar with the realm of martial apprentices and warriors.It can send Fang Che into the realm of a warrior with extreme reliability.But something unexpected happened.The predecessor died as a result.The eldest cousin who came to help enthusiastically slapped his cousin's Dantian with his palm, and when he used his own cultivation to stimulate his cousin's Dantian Qi... the cousin said nothing, and there was a snap.Lying on the ground dead!.........The eldest cousin was stunned on the spot.Did I kill my cousin?!This is so simple!The entire Fang family mobilized, begging grandpa to sue grandma, and all the miracle doctors in the city were invited to save his cousin - so Fang Che came.My cousin seems to be alive.But the eldest cousin is now being hung up and whipped by his uncle.The scene was said to be brutal....Fang Che used his existing pitiful spiritual power to carefully inspect the meridians, and finally discovered...that there was indeed something strange in the Dantian.Although with the current spiritual power, it is not too specific to detect, but according to Fang Che's experience, the one who can do this should be the Five Spirit Gu of the Solipsism.The so-called Five Spirit Gu is said to be a Gu insect that cultivates the five spiritual powers of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth for the human body.It is a poisonous poison that can harm people, but it is also some kind of secret skill, because if the Devouring Spirit does not die, it has certain qualifications and can assist in cultivation... To put it simply, if you do not die, you will become stronger.This is also a kind of selection, but at the cost of life and death.This is the usual method of a certain religion.Once the Five Spirit Gu enters the body, it cannot be refined at any level!Where did this Five Spirit Gu come from?Fang Che is searching his memory.It seems...that guy?Remember that before the breakthrough, a 'good friend' of the original self gave him a bottle of 'high-end' Qi and Blood Pill?But the original body had already eaten up all the food in order to break through.Other than that, nothing is different.It's almost like ten, that's probably it."What a good friend!"...Thousands of miles away.A man in white is coming here."Three hundred Five Spirit Gu, all dead? Only one survived? Only this one, still alive and strong? Who is this from? This direction...Bibo City?" "A random little arrangement, I didn't expect there was an unexpected surprise." He smiled in surprise and couldn't help but quicken his pace.It seems that this time, not only can the mission within the sect be completed, but also a successor disciple can be accepted?...Fang Che sorted out a laundry list of questions.There is no doubt that there are countless conspiracy calculations and interest entanglements that the predecessor was completely unaware of.There are so many threads tangled together that it is difficult to sort them out."The water is too deep here, brother, you can't control it."
